testSuite.name: fixed_preference_and_manual_review_conflict
testSuite.description: Fixed-rate preference applies (Rule 1) and low credit score triggers manual review (Rule 3); rules do not state precedence.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (Fixed30 via fixedPreference/high sensitivity) and Rule 3 (ManualReview via creditScore<640/dti>50/ltv>95) both match; rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview; Fixed30 chosen as first-listed rule.

testSuite.name: fixed_sensitivity_and_high_dti_conflict
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity (Rule 1) and DTI above 50 (Rule 3) both match.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (Fixed30) and Rule 3 (ManualReview) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview; Fixed30 chosen as first-listed rule.

testSuite.name: fixed_preference_and_arm_conditions_conflict
testSuite.description: Fixed-rate preference (Rule 1) and all ARM conditions (Rule 2) are met simultaneously.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (Fixed30) and Rule 2 (ARM7/1) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1; Fixed30 chosen as first-listed rule.

testSuite.name: null_credit_score_missing_value
testSuite.description: Credit score missing; ARM condition cannot be confirmed and manual review condition cannot be evaluated.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; rules do not state how missing values are handled. Possible outputs: no product (empty) or ManualReview; empty chosen as most likely.
